Chapter 318: Chapter 16: Obtaining the Treasure (Please Subscribe)

Personal Space.

Lin Yuan raised the glass on the table and took a casual sip.

“This Golden Dragon Star Domain is truly domineering, to actually threaten a Sixth-Level Citizen?” Lin Yuan put down the glass and shook his head slightly.

But as Sixth-Level Citizens, there are distinctions.

Some Evolvers became Sixth-Level Citizens by slaying Different Species, earning a large number of Merit Points in the process.

Others advanced to Sixth-Level Citizenship through invention and research, breaking new ground in technological achievements.

...

And there were Evolvers like Lin Yuan who opened up an Evolution Path, ultimately advancing to Sixth-Level Citizenship.

Without a doubt, those who open up Evolution Paths are the rarest among Sixth-Level Citizens.

Lin Yuan and Shi Feng belonged to this category, or rather, high-level citizens from the Founders’ Virtual World all fall into this group.

But no matter how rare, they were still only Sixth-Level Citizens.

Within the Human Civilization Alliance, Sixth-Level Citizens have a very high status, but unless they hold important positions, they don’t have much power.

Ordinary Evolvers and Citizens dare not show any disrespect when they meet a Sixth-Level Citizen, but the Golden Dragon Star Domain is different.

As one of the top three powerful Star Domains in the Annan Star Alliance, the Golden Dragon Star Domain does not need to please other Sixth-Level Citizens as much as the Wangyue Starfield strives to do.

After all, the Golden Dragon Star Domain itself has cultivated many Sixth-Level Citizens and has numerous friends; such is the confidence of a powerful Star Domain.

“That’s also true.”

“After all, I have not revealed my other identities; in the eyes of Jin Tianzhao, I am just a newly promoted Sixth-Level Citizen, likely to remain so for the rest of my life, so there’s no need to take me too seriously,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

A Sixth-Level Citizen who wishes to advance to Seventh-Level Citizenship needs two million Merit Points.

Such a vast amount of Merit Points gives even the Golden Dragon Star Domain a headache, let alone a newly promoted Sixth-Level Citizen.

Nearly ninety-nine percent of Sixth-Level Citizens are unable to accumulate two million Merit Points in their lifetime.

“Shisan.”

At this moment, Shi Feng returned and greeted Lin Yuan.

“That Jin Tianzhao, he’s just like that, too proud, don’t take it to heart,” Shi Feng comforted.

He only had a casual acquaintance with Jin Tianzhao; if it wasn’t for the affair between the Wangyue Starfield and the Golden Dragon Star Domain, he wouldn’t have invited Jin Tianzhao over.

“It’s fine.”

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

It didn’t matter whether it was Jin Tianzhao,

or even the Golden Dragon Star Domain.

At most, they would make empty threats.

As for going further, they wouldn’t dare; the three goddesses of the Human Alliance were not for show, prohibiting escalation of internal conflicts was a red line.

Besides,

Even if Jin Tianzhao wanted to do something, he did not know Lin Yuan’s true identity.

The identity that Lin Yuan showed to the outside world was, at most, that of a Sixth-Level Citizen of the Annan Star Alliance, with good relations with Shi Feng, a member of the Founders’ World.

More than that?

Perhaps Shi Feng guessed that Lin Yuan was not very old, but that was all.

“But the Golden Dragon Star Domain is indeed powerful, having independently opened up three Battlefields of Different Races, fighting against three species with the strength of a single domain…”

Shi Feng said in amazement.

“The Golden Dragon Star Master is indeed remarkable,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The might of the Golden Dragon Star Master was not inferior to that of Chikun Star Lord, belonging to the level of invincible existence among Eighth Layer Evolvers.

In the vast Annan Star Alliance with hundreds of Star Domains, there were more than a thousand Eighth Layer Evolvers, but only a few were on the same level as Chikun Star Lord and Golden Dragon Star Master.

With such a Star Master at its helm, the Golden Dragon Star Domain already possessed the strength to independently open up Battlefields of Different Races.

To the Golden Dragon Star Domain, these battlefields were a source of copious Merit Points as well as a training ground for their Evolvers.

Indeed.

The Chikun Star Domain had also independently opened up four Battlefields of Different Races.

However, the ones in the Chikun Star Domain did not have Permanent Spatial Rifts.

Permanent Spatial Rifts can only be formed by the powers of a Supreme Being.

The power of a Supreme Being referred to here does not require the Supreme Being to act personally; Supreme Weapons can also achieve this, but the Permanent Spatial Rifts they create are far smaller than those formed by a Supreme Being’s direct intervention.

Even so,

Most Battlefields of Different Races do not possess Permanent Spatial Rifts.

“Alright.”

“Don’t worry too much about Jin Tianzhao.”

“With Shisan’s talent, he’ll have his comeuppance in the future.”

Shi Feng said, seemingly probing.

Through his interactions with Lin Yuan, he felt that Lin Yuan must be quite young.

He definitely would not exceed a thousand years old. At such a young age to have advanced to Sixth-Level Citizenship and to be a member of the Founders’ World, clearly the Evolution Path he opened was no simple feat.

“You jest, Shi Feng,”

“What means do I have to make the Golden Dragon Star Domain suffer?” Lin Yuan said with a laugh.

If Shi Feng had known Lin Yuan’s real age in the Main World was not yet thirty, he would probably not probe but first make sure he wasn’t dreaming.

“So now do I choose the Wangyue Starfield?” Lin Yuan asked.

Since the Golden Dragon Star Domain had no intention of compensating him, Lin Yuan’s vote would naturally go to the Wangyue Starfield.

After all, he was rather covetous of that Seventh-Rank Soul Defense Treasure; it could be useful for a while.

“No rush, no rush.”

“As Sixth-Level Citizens, we only have one vote in each Star Alliance conference. Let’s wait and see. As long as it doesn’t concern our home Star Domain or any Star Domain with which we have a history, we’ll support whoever offers the best price,” Shi Feng said.

Any issue brought up at the Star Alliance conference would be such that, regardless of which side triumphed, there would be no significant impact on the overall situation of Human Civilization.
